items.title_zh: 基于 EEG 的 Unity 脑机接口控制项目
bullets_zh: 该 GitHub 项目于 2026-09-22 发布，提供基于 EEG 的实时 Unity 游戏控制脑机接口。
它结合信号处理、CSP/LDA 分类和 LSL 通信，将脑电信号转化为游戏输入。
适合开发者构建消费级或研究原型时参考的非侵入式 BCI 实践示例。
bullets_en: GitHub project published on 2026-09-22 provides an EEG-based BCI for real-time Unity game control.
It combines signal processing, CSP/LDA classification and LSL communication to turn brain signals into game inputs.
Useful as a practical non-invasive BCI demo for developers building consumer or research prototypes.
items.brief: 基于 EEG 的 Unity 实时控制项目，展示非侵入式 BCI 应用。
items.brief_en: EEG-based Unity control project demonstrating non-invasive BCI signal processing and classification.
items.raw_excerpt: EEG-based brain-computer interface for real-time Unity game control using signal processing, CSP/LDA classification and LSL communication.

items.title_en: AxonOS Community Radar for Open BCI
bullets_zh: 该 GitHub 项目于 2026-09-22 发布，维护一个自动更新的开放脑机接口领域地图。
它聚合社区资源和项目，帮助用户追踪非侵入式 BCI 生态发展。
对探索开放 BCI 工具的研究者、开发者和消费者具有发现价值。
bullets_en: GitHub project published on 2026-09-22 maintains an auto-updated map of the open brain-computer-interface field.
It aggregates community resources and projects, helping users track non-invasive BCI ecosystem developments.
Valuable as a discovery layer for researchers, developers and consumers exploring open BCI tools.

items.title_zh: 用于脑机接口的 EEG-Deformer PyTorch 实现
bullets_zh: 该 GitHub 项目于 2026-09-21 发布，提供密集卷积 Transformer EEG-Deformer 的 PyTorch 实现。
它面向从非侵入式 EEG 信号解码心理状态，用于脑机接口应用。
对评估 EEG 分类深度学习模型的研究者相关，但它不是基准数据集更新。
bullets_en: GitHub project published on 2026-09-21 provides a PyTorch implementation of the dense convolutional transformer EEG-Deformer.
It targets decoding mental states from non-invasive EEG signals for BCI applications.
Relevant to researchers evaluating deep-learning models for EEG classification, though it is not a benchmark dataset update.
items.brief: EEG-Deformer的PyTorch实现，用于非侵入式脑电解码与BCI研究。
items.brief_en: PyTorch implementation of EEG-Deformer for decoding non-invasive EEG signals in BCI research.
items.raw_excerpt: Decode EEG signals using this PyTorch implementation of a dense convolutional transformer for brain-computer interface applications.

items.title_zh: ADS1299 核心 SDK 开源脑电/脑机接口生态
items.title_en: ADS1299 Core SDK Open EEG/BCI Ecosystem
bullets_zh: 提供覆盖 8–64 通道硬件、MCU/FPGA 目标与参考包的开源 ADS1299 EEG/BCI 生态。
包含 PC/移动端/Linux 集成，以及 Python/MATLAB/R 脑电分析、验证与教学流程。
bullets_en: Provides an open ADS1299 EEG/BCI ecosystem spanning 8–64 channel hardware, MCU/FPGA targets and reference packages.
Includes PC/mobile/Linux integration plus Python/MATLAB/R workflows for EEG analysis, validation and education.
items.brief: 开源 ADS1299 EEG/BCI SDK，覆盖硬件、固件与分析，适合非侵入式脑电开发。
items.brief_en: Open-source ADS1299 EEG/BCI SDK covering hardware, firmware and analysis for non-invasive EEG development.
items.raw_excerpt: Building the world’s largest and most comprehensive open ADS1299 EEG/BCI ecosystem — 8–64CH hardware, 200 MCU/SoC/DSP & FPGA target/reference packages, Verilog RTL, PC/mobile/Linux integration, Python/MATLAB/R EEG analysis, BCI workflows, validation, education and research.

items.title_zh: [GitHub] Rice NeuroWave黑客松2026：EEG运动想象分类
items.title_en: [GitHub] Rice NeuroWave Hackathon 2026 EEG Motor Imagery
bullets_zh: 提供基于Python的跨被试EEG运动想象分类。
使用黎曼对数协方差与带功率特征，并按参与者分组交叉验证。
采用XGBoost折集成，单脚本运行且无需GPU。
bullets_en: Provides cross-subject EEG motor imagery classification in Python.
Uses Riemannian log-covariance and bandpower features with participant-grouped CV.
Employs an XGBoost fold ensemble in one script without GPU requirements.
items.brief: 该黑客松项目用Python实现跨被试EEG运动想象BCI，采用黎曼特征与XGBoost。
items.brief_en: Python hackathon project for cross-subject EEG motor-imagery BCI using Riemannian features and XGBoost.
items.raw_excerpt: Cross-subject EEG motor imagery classification (BCI) in Python: Riemannian log-covariance + bandpower features, participant-grouped CV, XGBoost fold ensemble. One script, no GPU.

bullets_en: Implements pure-Rust NeuroRVQ inference using Burn 0.20.
Tokenizes EEG, ECG, and EMG signals without Python dependencies.
Useful for lightweight Rust-based neurophysiological signal processing pipelines.

早期预警监测有助于维持安全可靠的非侵入式BCI使用。
bullets_en: Year 1 research project investigating early-warning signals for potential BCI deterioration.
Hosted as a GitHub repository for the first-year BCI research effort.
Early-warning monitoring can help maintain safe and reliable non-invasive BCI use.

It is useful for building consumer BCI apps without invasive hardware.
